about: Outside research: parking / access hunt (Brandon Oct 31 5:14 PM), US 5,733 + Canada 5,511 parks with no parking point. 'layers' = the agency-wide parking / access / facility point layers found (for the access bot to pin-test like its own sources); 'rows' per park. LAYER FOUND often means the agency's layer exists but has no point for this park (see notes). Nothing live without chat 11.

https://data.calgary.ca/resource/gkju-5p.field: asset_type says what each polygon is; 'PARKING LOT' (953 lots) is the parking value (other values include 'PICNIC AREA', 'ACCESS ROAD', 'PLAZA', 'MAINTENANCE COMPOUND'). Lots are tied to a park by lying inside its polygon in the City's Parks Sites layer (data.calgary.ca kami-qbfh, site_name). Filter: asset_type = 'PARKING LOT' AND asset_cd IN ('NPK454')
